citation: Kwon et al. 2025. Comparison of cardiorespiratory responses between treadmill and bicycle ergometer exercise. Journal of Exercise Rehabilitation
protocol: Resting phase then three talk-test stages of increasing intensity, on treadmill and on bicycle; cardiorespiratory variables by stage
note: Mean +/- SD by stage for each mode. Stage intensity is set by talk test; speed/grade or watts are not checked. Resting posture not verified.
